description: This file defines the 'Link' class used for managing relationships between objects in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including methods for retrieving, adding, deleting, and querying relationships, as well as handling related database operations.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Class for managing relationships between beans, including retrieval, addition, deletion, and query generation for related data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Link object with relationship details, bean reference, and configuration based on vardef.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Checks if the relationship record was successfully loaded.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves related record IDs or data based on relationship type and role.

methods.name: getRelatedTableName
methods.description: Returns the related table name based on bean position in the relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the related module name based on bean position.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns the relationship fields configuration.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Returns a specific related field by name.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the internal relationship object.

methods.name: _get_bean_position
methods.description: Determines if the bean is on the left or right side of the relationship.

methods.name: _is_self_relationship
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is self-referential.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates SQL JOIN clause(s) for the relationship based on parameters.

methods.name: _add_deleted_clause
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering deleted records.

methods.name: _add_optional_where_clause
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for optional filtering.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query for retrieving related records, supporting various relationship types and filters.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Retrieves related beans as per the query.

methods.name: _add_one_to_many_table_based
methods.description: Updates a one-to-many relationship table to link a record.

methods.name: _add_many_to_one_bean_based
methods.description: Associates a bean with a parent in a many-to-one relationship.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship link between objects, supporting one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many.

methods.name: _add_many_to_many
methods.description: Inserts or updates a record in a many-to-many join table.

methods.name: _delete_row
methods.description: Marks a row in a table as deleted.

methods.name: _update_row
methods.description: Updates a row in a table with new values.

methods.name: _insert_row
methods.description: Inserts a new row into a table.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a relationship link between objects, handling different relationship types.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship record exists in a join table based on key values.

methods.name: _get_alternate_key_fields
methods.description: Retrieves fields used for duplicate checking, prioritizing alternate keys.

methods.name: _get_link_table_definition
methods.description: Fetches metadata definitions for link tables, including indices and relationships.

methods.name: _get_link_table_role_field
methods.description: Returns the role field name for a many-to-many link table, if any.
